subject: Extremely slow internet at Basavanagudi store - impacting POS operations
description: Internet connectivity at SW-0109 has been severely degraded since approximately 14:45 today. All connected POS terminals, kitchen display systems, and customer-facing devices are experiencing significant latency and frequent disconnections. Network speeds have dropped from normal 50 Mbps to approximately 2-3 Mbps, causing delays in order processing and payment transactions. The NetLink router (RTR-0109-01) is powered on but unresponsive to standard troubleshooting.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Initial diagnostics show router is online but experiencing packet loss. Requested store manager to confirm if ISP line is active and check for physical cable disconnections.
